response.inner_monologue: Tom Bradley is out. Linda Park used the word structural and she was not wrong — she never is, apparently. I have been training for a transition I could see coming. I need to know who is hiring EV techs, what they want, and whether any of that is accessible from Millfield. I also need to stop being so heads-down that I lose touch with the people around me who are in harder spots. Zoe is adapting fast under real constraints. The least I can do is check in.
